correctness.rationale: Exact source certificate c(w)=1/(2^(w-1)-1)+1/[4(2^(w-1)-1)^2] has c_prime<0,c_second>0. The low-width reserve inequality gives k_r=floor(r(e-h)/(a-h)); the next stage q_r is bounded independently of r by (a-h)/(b-h). Thus greedy/r converges uniformly to chord H-(H-l)(e-h)/(a-h). The integer optimum is within O(1) of the two-segment lower convex envelope of (h,H),(b,m),(a,l) by rounding adjacent precision mixtures, uniformly in e∈[h,a]. Ratio of affine functions strictly rises then falls with unique maximum at e=b. Strict Jensen proves all-m uniquely optimal at finite rank at e=b; h=c(H)→0 gives linear H growth. Independently recomputed exact 64-rank counts (3,15,46), payload 1676 vs 768, ratio 419/192 and limiting ratio 2.5428114074. Finite checks do not prove uniform convergence.
residual_risks: Only certificate-constrained payload, equal strictly positive singular weights, exactly three precision levels; no hardware error guarantee beyond source certificate.
